name: Track3D support users
summary: How Track3D staff act inside customer projects, and what customers see of them.

roles.note: Support mode depends on a stored user flag, not on a role. Its scope per route is unconfirmed (see evidence/2026-10-28/capability-matrix.md).

actions.action: See support users in customer lists

nfr.statement: How long support actions in customer projects are kept in an audit trail, and who can see it.
nfr.open_question: Do customers need to see (or request) an audit of what Track3D staff did in their project?

requirements.title: Support mode needs a support-flagged account
requirements.statement: A request can act in support mode only if the signed-in user is flagged as a Track3D support user. A support header sent by anyone else is ignored.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer user without the support flag
acceptance_criteria.when: They send the support header on a request
acceptance_criteria.then: The request is handled as an ordinary customer request

requirements.title: Support users are hidden from customers
requirements.statement: Support users don't appear in customers' user lists or user counts. Today the code leaves them out of group member lists and keeps a separate non-support user count.

sources.title: Prior PRD - User management / user profile (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

open_checks: A demo session in support context showed only labels and controls. Hidden-from-customer behaviour wasn't tested with a customer principal

acceptance_criteria.given: A support user is a member of a project
acceptance_criteria.when: A customer views that project's user list

requirements.title: Support actions are attributed to Track3D
requirements.statement: A support user's actions on another support user send no notifications. Notifications about a support user's actions on customers name the company, not the staff member.
requirements.rationale: The PRD uses the old company name "ConstructN". Product should confirm the name shown today.

sources.title: Prior PRD - User management / user profile (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

acceptance_criteria.given: A support user changes another support user's role
A support user updates a customer's task
acceptance_criteria.then: The notification names Track3D (historically "ConstructN") rather than the staff member

requirements.title: Support users see real user identities and have extra capabilities
requirements.statement: Support users see the real user IDs on tasks, and Track3D staff have additional capabilities beyond customer roles. Which capabilities is not defined.

sources.title: Prior PRD - User management / user profile (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

acceptance_criteria.given: A support user viewing a task
acceptance_criteria.then: The actual user IDs are visible
